snippet.title: Fourleaf Fields Gameplay Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Fourleaf Fields is a cozy tiny-world farming sim where you grow giant crops, care for adorable bugs, and uncover the town’s secrets through gossip. This exclusive trailer reveals new veggies, new bugs like the rhino bug and snail, new characters including Jules, Maya, and Luke, and new locations such as the Community Kitchen and the Forest. Coming to Steam! https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
